errors.text_span: най-високият стълб отговаря на „висше образование“ с 86%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the highest bar. The highest bar corresponds to the category 'растиниевъдни' (crop farms) with a value of 82%. The bar for 'висше образование' (higher education) is the lowest, with a value of 38%. The value of 86% is also incorrect.

The description states that all bars have the same dimensions ('размери'). This is incorrect as the bars have different heights, which is the key feature used to represent the different percentage values.
